1	/**
2	 * Agent-scoped dispatch and prompt assembly helpers. The fused dispatcher
3	 * {@link agentEvents} couples the agent subject to its scope carrier, so the
4	 * scope key and the payload's `agent` cannot diverge; repeat dispatchers (the
5	 * loop driver) build it once in the agent's constructor and reuse it.
6	 * @module @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent/dispatch
7	 */
8	
9	import type { Context, Events } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
10	import { scopeTarget } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope'
11	import type { Scoped } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope'
12	import type { AssembleContext } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt'
13	import type { Agent } from './types.ts'
14	
15	/** Extract the parameter tuple from an event handler type (its `this` is not part of the tuple). */
16	type Params<F> = F extends (...args: infer P) => unknown ? P : never
17	/** Extract the return type from an event handler type. */
18	type Return<F> = F extends (...args: never[]) => infer R ? R : never
19	
20	/**
21	 * The event names whose subject is an agent: the handler's first parameter is
22	 * a payload object carrying the `agent` subject AND the handler declares a
23	 * `Scoped<Agent>` `this` (the scope-carrier contract). The `this` check keeps
24	 * accidental payload-happens-to-carry-an-Agent events (or zero-arg events,
25	 * whose parameter tuple would satisfy a bare rest-tuple check via callability)
26	 * out of the fused-dispatch surface.
27	 */
28	export type AgentSubjectEvent = {
29	  [K in keyof Events]: Events[K] extends (this: Scoped<Agent>, ...args: infer P) => unknown
30	    ? P extends [infer Payload, ...unknown[]]
31	      ? Payload extends { agent: Agent } ? K : never
32	      : never
33	    : never
34	}[keyof Events]
35	
36	/** The full payload object of one agent-subject event. */
37	type PayloadOf<K extends AgentSubjectEvent> = Params<Events[K]> extends [infer Payload, ...unknown[]] ? Payload : never
38	
39	/** The event arguments AFTER the payload: the waterfall `next` when present. */
40	type Tail<K extends AgentSubjectEvent> = Params<Events[K]> extends [unknown, ...infer R] ? R : never
41	
42	/**
43	 * The payload as emit-side callers pass it: the full payload minus the agent
44	 * field, which the fused dispatcher injects so subject and scope key cannot
45	 * diverge.
46	 */
47	type PayloadRest<K extends AgentSubjectEvent> = Omit<PayloadOf<K> & object, 'agent'>
48	
49	/**
50	 * The fused dispatcher {@link agentEvents} returns: each method dispatches the
51	 * named agent-subject event with the agent's scope carrier as `thisArg` and
52	 * the agent itself injected into the payload.
53	 */
54	export interface AgentEventDispatch {
55	  /**
56	   * Fire-and-forget notification in the agent's scope. Every listener is
57	   * invoked; synchronous throws and returned-promise rejections are logged and
58	   * contained per listener, so a notification cannot veto lifecycle progress
59	   * or starve a later observer.
60	   * @param name - the agent-subject event to emit.
